title: Tide and Orchard
author: Gideon Okafor
blurb: Ada Okafor, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
